description: What the user chose in TmModelPicker: which model, whether extended thinking is on and which reasoning-effort level is set — the whole two-way bound value (@bind-Selection). The record is a VALUE: the picker raises a new instance on every change (a pick of a DIFFERENT model resets the reasoning options to that model's defaults, a re-pick of the SAME model keeps them), so a host can store it as-is and compare it with ==. Null means "nothing chosen yet". A programmatic switch through ForModel keeps the reasoning options verbatim — see its remarks; use new AiModelSelection(modelId) for the picker's reset semantics.
